name: session-handoff-button
description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, colored by context usage; reads Context clean and cannot be pressed while green. From orange on, one press writes the handoff, saves it to a temp .md, clears the session and continues in the fresh one with a short message while the handoff goes in as hidden context. Past 65% it stops your next prompt once and recommends the button.

skill.title: Handoff skill
skill.description: Slash command that writes the handoff (without the slash). When it is not installed, the built-in handoff prompt is used.

autoSend.title: Send automatically
autoSend.description: After /clear, send the short continue message automatically. Off: put it in the prompt box and wait for Enter (the handoff is already in the fresh session).
